create.name: Julie Smith
create.bio:
Julie Smith is a meditation teacher who works mainly with busy professionals, drawing on more than twenty years in corporate management before she began teaching. She studied Eastern philosophy and meditation across Asia, Europe and North America, from Nepal and Thailand to Scotland, and names the Buddhist scholar and contemplative teacher B. Alan Wallace as her principal teacher. She is also a board member of a charity, the Contemplative Consciousness Network, that brings meditation and science together.

Her teaching is plain and non-religious, aimed at people who want to calm a busy mind, sleep better, ease stress and avoid burnout so they have more energy for work and family. She runs membership-based evening classes on Zoom in two streams, a one-hour foundation class for newer meditators and a two-hour advanced class for those who already practise regularly, with recordings so members can catch up. She also gives private sessions online or at Violet Hill Studios in Maida Vale, London, and offers a one-week personal retreat near the coastal town of Denia in Spain, built around a programme that helps guests fix a daily meditation habit. Newcomers can start with a free five-part video series that covers getting started, common obstacles and a guided relaxation.

courses.title: Interactive Online Meditation Classes
courses.description: Monthly membership for live evening meditation classes on Zoom: a one-hour Foundation class for newer meditators and a two-hour Advanced class for regular practitioners, up to three classes a month, with recordings. Members can change level or cancel at any time.

courses.title: Private Meditation Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one meditation tuition tailored to the student's aims, held on Zoom, at the student's home or workplace, or at a studio in St John's Wood, London, by arrangement. Single hours or courses of three, six or eight sessions.
courses.price: £100.00 GBP (1 hour, my location); £125.00 GBP (1 hour, your location); £300.00 GBP (3 week course); £600.00 GBP (6 week course); £800.00 GBP (8 week course)

courses.title: Personal Work/Life Balance Retreat in Spain
courses.description: A one-week personal meditation retreat in Denia on Spain's Mediterranean coast, with a programme tailored to each guest to build a daily meditation habit, followed by two online group classes and two check-in calls. Booked for any available week from September to June.

free_resources.title: Success Through Stillness: Discover Meditation
free_resources.description: A free series of five short videos: how to get started and stay motivated, the three biggest obstacles to meditating, a guided relax-and-release meditation, practical tips, and how long to sit and how to re-centre during the day. Access by email sign-up.
